description: Allow a paired shipper to self-revoke its own deployment. Per spec §14.1 pin 2 the deployment_id is SERVER-DERIVED from state.authenticated_principal.client_id — the handler accepts NO caller-supplied deployment_id. Transitions deployment paired → revoked. Part of M5 shipper bootstrap pairing flow.
